description:
[Reports] Run a report and return each block's rows (aggregated numbers, at most 500 rows per block). Three ways: `report_id` of a saved custom report (your saved filters, then `filters`, apply; with `version` a newer report is refused with 409); `report_id` builtin:<name> of a built-in report from list_reports (`section`, `from` / `to`, `position_id` or `interview_id`, `limit` / `offset`; sections that list candidates by name run only with include_candidates=true and are audited); or an unsaved `definition`, which is validated against list_report_fields and run without storing anything: check a definition this way before save_report, a wrong block comes back with ok=false and an error naming the field and the valid ids. Report numbers are decision-support material for a human reviewer.

Every argument in full, with examples: get_tool_reference.

block_id.description: Run only this block (custom reports only; built-in reports take section).

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

allOf.description: Applied on top of definition.filters (custom reports only).

from.description: Built-in reports only: first day of the period (YYYY-MM-DD, UTC, inclusive). Default: 30 days before `to` (90 for fairness).

include_candidates.description: Built-in reports only: also run the sections that list candidates by name (candidates true in list_reports). Default false.

interview_id.description: Built-in reports only: one interview (interview_def_set.id), for the sections that take it.

limit.description: Built-in reports only: rows per section (1 to 500). Default 50, or 20 for a section of large rows (ATS jobs).

llm_model.description: Your model id, e.g. "claude-opus-4-8"; "unknown" if unsure. For analytics.

merchant_id.description: Optional merchant to act on. Admins and sub-merchant operators only; other callers always use their token's merchant.

offset.description: Built-in reports only: rows to skip in each section (default 0); see each block's pagination.

position_id.description: Built-in reports only: one position (position_def_set.id), for the sections that take it (filters in list_reports).

report_id.description: Instead of definition: run a saved custom report (its uuid; your saved filters, then filters, apply) or a built-in report id (builtin:<name>, from list_reports scope builtin).

section.description: Built-in reports only: run only this section (ids in list_reports). Default: every section.

stage.description: builtin:fairness_monitoring only: pre_screening, ai_interview (default) or final.

to.description: Built-in reports only: last day of the period (YYYY-MM-DD, UTC, inclusive). Default: today. At most 400 days after `from`.

version.description: With a custom report_id: the version you read; a newer one is refused with 409.

name: run_report
title: Run a report
